design_philosophy: Claude/Emergent chat aesthetic: Clean, minimalist, highly functional, distraction-free IDE chat interface. Emphasis on beautiful typography, subtle borders, and a calm, off-white/gray color palette with occasional terracotta brand accents.

layout.structure: Split-pane layout. Left: Chat container. Right: Preview/Terminal (IDE) panel.
layout.chat_container: flex-1 flex flex-col h-screen max-w-3xl mx-auto relative
layout.ide_panel: hidden lg:flex w-[45vw] h-screen border-l border-zinc-200 bg-zinc-50 flex-col shadow-[-8px_0_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)] z-40 transition-transform duration-300
layout.spacing: Generous. p-4 to p-8 for containers. gap-6 between messages.

components.chat_message_user: flex justify-end mb-6 w-full. Inner bubble: bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-900 px-5 py-3.5 rounded-3xl rounded-br-sm max-w-[85%] sm:max-w-[75%] shadow-sm
components.chat_message_ai: flex justify-start mb-8 gap-4 w-full. Inner text: bg-transparent text-zinc-900 py-1.5 max-w-[100%] leading-relaxed
components.input_container: absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4 bg-gradient-to-t from-white via-white to-transparent pb-8
components.input_box: relative bg-white border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm rounded-2xl p-3 focus-within:shadow-md focus-within:border-zinc-300 transition-all duration-200 w-full flex items-end gap-2
components.action_button_primary: bg-[#D97757] text-white hover:bg-[#C26246] rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
components.action_button_ghost: text-zinc-500 hover:bg-zinc-100 hover:text-zinc-900 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm transition-colors
components.ide_tabs: flex gap-2 p-2 border-b border-zinc-200 bg-white items-center justify-between
components.settings_modal: bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-zinc-100 p-6 max-w-md w-full

interactions.panel_slide: Smooth transform translation for the right panel opening/closing (like Claude Artifacts).

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5, size 18px or 20px for UI actions. size 24px for AI avatar/sparkles.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. Examples: data-testid='chat-input', data-testid='send-button', data-testid='settings-trigger', data-testid='preview-tab', data-testid='terminal-tab', data-testid='push-github-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI strictly using React .js files (no .tsx).
Use Tailwind CSS for styling, adhering to the palette and typography defined here.
Implement Shadcn UI components for complex interactions (Dialog for Settings/Github modals, Tabs for Preview/Terminal, DropdownMenu for options).
Make the chat interface feel exactly like Claude: user messages in gray bubbles aligned right, AI messages plain text aligned left with a nice AI avatar icon (e.g., Sparkles).
The Preview/Terminal panel should function like Claude's Artifacts panel, taking up the right half of the screen on desktop when active.
Implement a clean, floating chat input anchored at the bottom with a subtle gradient mask behind it so text scrolls cleanly underneath.
Include all requested features: Settings modal, GitHub integration modal, file attachment button, and IDE actions (Push, Start/Stop dev server, Refresh preview) in the IDE panel header.
Ensure the design is fully mobile-responsive (panels might stack or use modals on small screens).
